resume: FM-106 brings the Roland Juno-106 analog synth to the FM-1: six voices, 128 factory presets and the MN3009 BBD chorus.

commandes.role: Changes the chorus mode: OFF, I, II, I+II.
Toggles the VCA between ENV and GATE.
Jumps to the Envelope edit page.
Jumps to the LFO / ARP edit page.
Turns the arpeggiator on or off.
Browses and loads the 128 Juno-106 presets.

modes.texte: VCF / DCO (cutoff, resonance, env mod, sub), ENVELOPE (ADSR), DCO / PWM (LFO depth, PWM, noise, HPF), LFO / ARP (LFO rate and delay, arp rate and range). The four rotary knobs set the page's four values.
